title: I tried turning one of my own awkward life moments into a branching story
author: Helpful-Guava7452
selftext:
Lately I’ve been messing around with taking random, awkward real-life moments and turning them into little branching stories. Nothing dramatic or fancy—just the normal cringey human stuff.

Like accidentally waving at the wrong person, blanking on someone’s name mid-conversation, saying the wrong thing and then overthinking it for three days straight. All the relatable chaos.

I tried it using Pop Park, and it was surprisingly fun watching one tiny moment split into different outcomes based on small choices. It didn’t even feel like writing; it felt more like just remixing my own life a little.

If anyone wants to mess around with it too, here’s the app:[Pop Park](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.poppark.remix&pli=1)

It’s a pretty low-pressure way to turn everyday awkwardness into little story ideas
